title: Mixer local reference release protocol v1

canonicalization.map_order: bytewise lexicographic order of encoded keys
canonicalization.data_model: text keys and values, unsigned integers, arrays, maps and booleans; all declared struct fields included, no nulls or omitted fields
canonicalization.artifact_signature: Ed25519(mixer.artifact.v1 followed by one NUL byte followed by canonical CBOR manifest)
canonicalization.assignment_signature: Ed25519(mixer.assignment.v1 followed by one NUL byte followed by canonical CBOR assignment)
canonicalization.artifact_identity: lowercase SHA256 hex of canonical CBOR manifest
canonicalization.signature_transport: RFC4648 standard padded base64 text encoding exactly 64 signature bytes; reject numeric arrays, CR/LF, missing padding and nonzero pad bits
canonicalization.byte_transport: All JSON byte strings, including pinned public keys and HTTP payloads, use canonical RFC4648 standard padded base64 text; decoding and re-encoding must reproduce the decoded JSON string exactly
canonicalization.json_shape: Closed signed envelopes, manifest, assignment, scope, limits, host and trust-root objects require every declared field, including zero integers and false booleans; field names match exactly after JSON escape decoding. Reject case aliases, unknown fields, duplicate decoded names, nulls and trailing JSON values. capability_hashes and asset_hashes keys remain dynamic, case-sensitive identifiers; distinct SCHEMA, Schema and schema keys are not aliases
canonicalization.json_integer_transport: Unsigned integer fields require JSON integer syntax in uint64 range; reject fractional/exponent forms, negative zero and overflow
canonicalization.json_document_bytes: 1..1048576 bytes per v1 signed/configuration protocol document, including outer whitespace, at bounded DecodeJSON/Swift StrictJSON entry points; standard json.Unmarshal strips outer whitespace before model callbacks and is not a transport size guard
canonicalization.go_model_reuse: Closed v1/v2 model JSON decoders replace the complete receiver only after successful structural decoding; incoming empty maps replace prior maps and failed decoding preserves the receiver. Structural decoding is not signature, compatibility or execution authorization. Generic configuration DTO missing-field/default behavior remains separate

manifest_fields.runtime: 64 lowercase hex exact installed runtime fingerprint
manifest_fields.capability_hashes: map identifier to 64 lowercase hex, exact host map match
manifest_fields.expanded_bytes: uint64 identical to compressed_bytes in v1
manifest_fields.asset_hashes: empty map only; separate assets fail closed until verified extraction exists
manifest_fields.source_map_sha256: 64 lowercase hex reference; source map is not executed or fetched by v1
manifest_fields.created_at_unix: positive uint64 audit time, not replay authority

assignment_fields.sequence: positive uint64 monotonically increasing within app/environment/platform/runtime/channel

identifier: 1..128 ASCII letters, numbers, dot, underscore or hyphen
cohort: SHA256 of canonical CBOR map {organization,project,app,environment,channel,installation}; treat digest as unsigned big-endian integer modulo 10000; eligible if less than signed rollout_basis_points. Stable expansion; installation ID is app-private random pseudonym, never account/customer data. Reinstallation generates new ID; account switching retains ID.
trust: Direct Ed25519 roots pinned in host/config, exact signed scope, independent artifact/assignment roles, explicit revocation and optional not-before/not-after. No delegation documents supported; unknown protocol features reject. Rotation needs preinstalled additional public root; compromised roots may need new binary. Existing healthy offline launches do not recheck root expiry.

http.authentication: Bearer token; only token SHA256 is in local service config. Reader/editor/publisher roles; project-bound tokens. No admin secret in device endpoint.
http.mutations: Idempotency-Key identifier required; exact route+body hash bound within tenant. Same key/body returns original result; different route/body returns 409. Atomic snapshot persists domain state, audit and durable outbox together.

promote.body: same as publish; strictly newer sequence and nondecreasing percentage for same artifact

rollback.body: same as publish; strictly newer sequence targeting a previously published compatible artifact

outbox.response: local pending work records; no external delivery is claimed

updates.authentication: none; only public signed delivery metadata

payload.authentication: none; only previously published immutable signed artifact and payload

http.errors: JSON {error:{code,message},request_id}; 400 malformed,401 unauthenticated,403 unauthorized,404 absent,409 conflict/replay,413 body too large,422 verification/compatibility,429 rate limit,503 durable-store failure
http.limits: max body 24 MiB, 128 concurrent requests, 120 requests per minute per source IP; response Retry-After=60; no mutable external jobs
http.production: refused; explicit developer mode and literal loopback listener required. Local filesystem durability only, not PostgreSQL/multi-host readiness. No HTTP signer or private key field.
